CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress SSH port to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to SSH port (TCP: 22).
Risk: This port manages secure shell remote administration. Attackers conduct brute-force attacks to gain shell access, establish persistence for botnets/malware, or use compromised systems as jump points for lateral movement within networks.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
